description: Create a recurring work schedule from an existing work item. The schedule will automatically generate new work items on the recurrence you set — confirm the recurrence details with the user before calling. Note: RecurrenceFrequency cannot be changed after creation.

AssigneeUserKey.description: UserKey to assign generated work items to

CreatedFromWorkItemKey.description: The WorkItemKey the schedule is created from

CustomFrequencyMultiple.description: Multiple of the frequency unit; use 1 unless RecurrenceFrequency is Custom

InitializeBeforeStartDateUnits.description: Create the work item this long before its start date

InitializeTasksBeforeStartDateUnits.description: Create the work item's tasks/budget this long before its start date

PreventStartEndOnWeekend.description: If true, generated work items never start on a weekend

ScheduleDueDateDays.description: The day count for the due date method (not used with LastDayOfMonth/NoDueDate)

ScheduleDueDateMonthMultiple.description: Only with DayOfSubsequentMonth: how many months later

ScheduleEndDate.description: ISO 8601 date the schedule stops; omit to run forever

WorkItemTitleDefinition.description: Title format for generated work items; supports Karbon title tokens (e.g. period/date placeholders)

name: create_work_schedule
title: Create work schedule
